grammarOverview.title: Precision Overview
grammarOverview.summary: Louise communicates effectively in extended spontaneous conversation. The next step is to make recurring language patterns more natural without interrupting the flow of ideas.
focusPoints: Refine collocations and prepositions that recur in meaningful discussion.
Strengthen verb patterns inside real explanations rather than isolated drills.
Use clearer sentence framing when an opinion or explanation becomes long.
Organize extended opinions with an opening position, supporting reasons or examples and a conclusion.
Use delayed correction: first keep the message moving, then revisit only two or three high-value language points.
